context.narrative_job: Separate going to market from completed transfer, then make the evidence limitation part of what the audience sees.
context.viewer_before: The intact business and absent paid readiness role are understood; entering the sale process may still feel like a near-complete sale.
context.viewer_after: A for-sale sign changes market status without completing the sale. The reported rough three-in-ten estimate is attributed to an interested source and does not forecast this owner.

data.choice: Keep the recognizable workshop; attach a for-sale sign without moving or damaging the business. Reveal a separate still-unresolved closing endpoint. Pin approximately three in ten to the completed-sale definition, cut to a typographic source/interest examination, then return to the same intact workshop and qualified aggregate direction.
data.reason: The sign can visibly change while ownership remains unresolved. The source examination changes the weight of the number rather than inventing seven observed failures; object permanence makes the distinction concrete.

alternatives.choice: Presenter or static three-in-ten title throughout
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Would explain the words but would not expose market-status change without ownership transfer; a new presenter take also requires separate paid work.

alternatives.choice: Ten-business funnel with seven falling through
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Would make a directional institutional estimate look like a measured cohort and invent specific failure outcomes.

reuse.applies_when: An entry status is mistaken for a completed outcome and a reported estimate needs source qualification.
reuse.avoid_when: A true measured cohort requires its actual denominator or the illustration would imply a forecast for a named case.

nuance.source_basis: Current agent proposal under owner direction to continue; not owner-accepted new scene.

animation.form: Persistent business status change, separate completion condition, attributable evidence interlude
animation.mark_style: Boundary Ledger authored rough contours, typeset evidence; single oxide distinction
animation.entry: Hard cut at existing prefix end; same workshop asset identifies continuity without changing accepted outgoing frames.
animation.change: For-sale sign attaches; sale completion remains a separate condition; evidence qualifications arrive at actual words.
animation.hold: Stillness supports listening; no idle movements.
animation.exit: Qualified aggregate direction; cut before S07 without clipping final sell.
